title: Spring opener helps fund accessibility hay wagon at Richardson Farms
summary: A spring opener event raised funds to purchase an accessibility hay wagon, allowing people with disabilities to enjoy hay rides at Richardson Farms.
body:
A spring opener event raised funds to purchase an accessibility hay wagon, allowing people with disabilities to enjoy hay rides at Richardson Farms.

title: Secretary Long outlines measures to improve access to Disability Tax Credit
summary: Secretary Long outlines measures to improve access to the Disability Tax Credit, which provides tax relief for persons with disabilities and serves as a gateway to other federal supports such as the Canada Disability Benefit and Registered Disability Savings Plan.
body:

title: Period support gaps create barriers for athletes with disabilities
summary: Research from Victoria University and Share the Dignity finds that lack of basic menstruation support, inadequate facilities, and limited privacy prevent women with disabilities from participating in sports.
body:
Research from Victoria University and Share the Dignity finds that lack of basic menstruation support, inadequate facilities, and limited privacy prevent women with disabilities from participating in sports.
